title: Vortex Sour Cherry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Sour Cherry combines the deep sweetness of ripe Cherry with a sharp sour twist, creating a bold and tangy vape. This flavour is ideal for vapers who enjoy rich fruit profiles with a tart edge, offering a balance of sweet and sour notes. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Sour Cherry provides smooth vapour and full-bodied flavour, making it suitable for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices. The nicotine salt formulation ensures smooth throat hits and fast nicotine relief, delivering a flavourful and satisfying vape. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts come in a 10ml format, offering a longer-lasting and more sustainable alternative to disposable vape bars. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Sour Cherry is a must-try for fans of fruity, sour flavours.
